messages:
Vika: quick sync — Q3 inference roadmap triage. We have limited eng bandwidth; need to pick two priority slices for Hosted Gen that move revenue/ops risk most. candidates: low-latency mobile chat (p95 target), embeddings SLA & throughput, lightweight rerank API for search, and cost-per-token reductions via quantization. Thoughts?

PJ: +1 to embeddings SLA. Big enterprise ask (vector DB partners) and easiest to productize.

Matt: mobile chat latency matters for consumer customers. we can target p95 300-400ms by improving batching + short-circuit KV cache. risky but high impact.

Sara: rerank API is small surface but high commercial value for search vendors. Requires endpoint-level batching and a simple schema for scores.

Devon: cost-per-token wins long-term but depends on compiler/kernel work that might slip. can be a continuous engineering project, not a Q3 bet if we need quick wins.

Vika: proposal: pick 2 slices: (A) Embeddings SLA & throughput (enterprise product, billing add-on) (B) Mobile low-latency chat (PLG stickiness). Rerank is fallback if we choose embeddings only.

PJ: alignment note — embeddings slice needs: SLA doc, per-customer capacity isolation, pricing model, and an SLO metric. also we need traceability to dedupe cached vectors.

Matt: for mobile chat we need these success criteria:
```
- p95 <= 350ms in us-east for 95% of requests
- degradation fallback to smaller model within 200ms
- no more than 2% error increase vs baseline
- end-to-end attach: SDK delta <= 50ms
```

Sara: rerank success criteria: 99th latency <= 200ms, top-1 precision uplift > 4% on eval set, and customer config UI. small infra change but UX + eval work.

Vika: deps list I see: runtime KV cache (eng-runtime), smarter batching (eng-platform), routing fallback (eng-infra), billing hooks (finance), SLO docs + contract (legal + sales). Anyone see missing deps?

Devon: add model catalog pinning for rollout, and a canary rollout plan that can route a % of traffic. rollout-bot pls schedule.

rollout-bot: scheduled canary window: start=1759007800 end=1759011400 — will run health checks and auto-rollback on 5xx spike or latency breach.

PJ: launch criteria (embeddings): SLA doc + per-cust isolation + performance tests + 2 pilot customers onboarded + pricing page.

Matt: launch criteria (mobile chat): perf targets met in two regions + SDK patches + mobile app pilot (internal + 1 external) + latency dashboards.

Vika: prioritization poll — react with :one: for (Embeddings + Rerank), :two: for (Embeddings + Mobile Chat), :three: for (Mobile Chat + Rerank). I'll close poll EOD Friday.

Sara: quick note — embeddings ask will unlock several active deals. +1 for option 2 but would accept 1.

Devon: engineering preference: 2 (Embeddings + Mobile) but we need a short spike to validate batching work 2 weeks in.

PJ: raising risk: if embedding SLA requires per-customer reserved capacity we might need Dedicated/Dedicated-like infra which has longer sales cycles. flagging for sales.

Vika: noted. action items:
- PJ to draft SLA + pilot checklist (due Tue)
- Matt to run 2-week spike on KV cache + batching (start Mon)
- Devon to draft canary playbook with rollback triggers (due Wed)
- Sara to scope rerank as a follow-up product PRD (optional)

Vika: thanks all — will tally reactions and set final slice decision by EOD Fri. keep threads for blockers only. :thumbsup:
